sections.title: Minor Requirements
sections.note: Students must complete the following requirements: Two FSAD course at the 1000 level (6 - 8 credits) Two FSAD courses at the 2000 or 3000 level (6 - 8 credits) One FSAD course at the 4000 or 6000 level (3 - 4credits) Only FSAD courses may be used to fulfill the minor.
